about.title: About pcMonitor
info.title: Information about pcMonitor
about.description: Local, read-only overview of hardware ports.
note.usb: Logical hub port. Includes internal ports; USB 2 and USB 3 may represent the same physical socket.
note.display: The driver reports connector status and supported modes. A connected display can be disabled.
note.network: Connected means link signal, not internet access. Cable presence may be unknown on an administratively disabled interface.
note.audio: Jack detection requires driver and audio-server support. “Unknown” does not mean empty.
note.audio_missing: Audio hardware exists, but pactl or the audio server is unavailable. Run without sudo in the logged-in graphical session.
note.storage: Kernel-reported SATA port. A drive is connected even when its filesystem is not mounted.
note.block: Detected drive. This does not imply knowledge of other empty physical slots.
note.pcie: Firmware/kernel-reported slot. These may be virtual slots in a virtual machine.
note.typec: Requires Type-C driver support. USB devices may also appear under USB.
note.thunderbolt: Detected Thunderbolt device; authorization is shown separately.
note.serial: Serial ports often cannot detect a device on a plain cable. A USB adapter is detected as connected.
admin.failed: HM203: Administrator authorization unavailable or cancelled. Normal detection remains active. Restart admin mode to try again.
value.admin: Additional information requires administrator read access.
value.dmi_missing: No readable memory module data. Install dmidecode or check firmware support.
value.smart_missing: No SMART data: smartmontools missing, access unavailable or query unsupported.
note.modules: Installed memory modules reported by firmware. Fields may be missing; clock and transfer rate retain reported units.
note.dmi: Firmware fields may be missing or contain placeholders. Serial numbers often require administrator access.
note.gpu: VRAM is shown only when the driver reports dedicated video memory. Shared RAM is not reported as VRAM.
note.disk: SMART is read in administrator mode using smartmontools and cached for up to 60 seconds. No self-tests are started.
export.csv_error: HM301: Could not save CSV. Check destination and write permissions.
export.print_error: HM302: Printing unavailable. Check printer and python3-cairo / python3-gi-cairo packages.
issue.access: No read permission for {name}. Start administrator mode to read this field. Retried on manual refresh or restart.
info.nvidia_unneeded: Not required – no NVIDIA graphics card detected
diagnosis.overview: Diagnostic notes for {count} entries – select a category:
diagnosis.missing_tool: {tool} is missing. Linux Mint provides these fields through package {package}. Install with: sudo apt install {package}
diagnosis.admin: Additional fields require administrator read access. Start the monitor in administrator mode; installing a package does not grant these permissions.
diagnosis.dmi_data: dmidecode is installed but returned no usable memory-module data. Check firmware/VM support and the query. This does not establish a missing package.
diagnosis.virtual_disk: Virtual VirtIO drive: the VM exposes no usable SMART data for the physical drive here. Additional guest packages do not resolve this. Check SMART on the host.
diagnosis.smart_query: smartctl is installed, but no usable SMART health data is available. Possible causes include standby, timeout, controller support or access failure. Check the SMART messages below; a missing package has not been established.
diagnosis.audio_query: pactl is installed, but the audio server is unavailable or the query failed. Check the normal graphical user session and audio service.
diagnosis.jack: The audio server does not report jack occupancy. This does not indicate a missing package or missing administrator permissions.
diagnosis.serial: This serial interface does not report reliable device presence. This status does not establish a need to install software.
diagnosis.vm_sensors: No readable temperature sensors are exposed in this VM. Guest administrator rights cannot create sensors; first check whether the hypervisor exposes them.
diagnosis.sensors: Linux exposes no readable temperature sensors. Possible causes include hardware/firmware support or a sensor driver. No package or module loading is recommended without an identified match.
diagnosis.edid: The display or connection supplies no readable EDID data. Check the cable, adapter and driver support; no specific missing package can be inferred.
diagnosis.nvidia_tool: An NVIDIA graphics card is detected, but nvidia-smi is missing. Use Linux Mint Driver Manager to check the driver matching the card. The utility belongs to the matching nvidia-utils version; no package version is recommended without matching the driver.
diagnosis.unbound: No driver is bound to PCI device {device}. A matching module may be missing or unloaded; disabled or reserved devices are also possible. This does not automatically mean a package is missing. Check the device ID and driver support.
diagnosis.usb_unbound: No driver is bound to USB interface {device}. Some vendor/userspace interfaces need no kernel driver. Check the device and interface function before installing anything.
diagnosis.firmware_data: A firmware/device identifier is missing or a placeholder. Installing software cannot supply identifiers the device does not report.
value.tpm_not_reported: Linux reports no TPM device. This does not prove that no TPM is installed.
value.logical: Logical interface, not a physical socket
diagnosis.extended_query: Additional data from {tool} is unavailable. Possible causes: failed query, time limit or missing permission. Refresh and check the tool.
value.bluetooth_not_reported: Linux reports no Bluetooth controller. A USB device alone does not prove a working Bluetooth adapter. Check driver binding under USB/PCIe.
packs.title: Install language and help
packs.hint: Search for available languages, select a language and install it. The language file and matching HTML help are downloaded together from GitHub. German and English are included.
packs.local: Install local language and help pack …
packs.success: ✓ Language {code} and help installed. Select the language above and save.
packs.error.HM501: HM501: Language file invalid or unreadable. Select a UTF-8 JSON file <language-code>.json containing text values and language.name (maximum 2 MiB).English must include all existing keys.
packs.error.HM502: HM502: Language server or manifest.json unavailable or invalid. Check the HTTPS address, Internet connection and manifest format. Redirects are not allowed. Local languages remain available.
packs.error.HM503: HM503: SHA256 checksum mismatch. File was not installed. Ask the provider for a corrected file.
packs.error.HM504: HM504: Cannot save language and help pack. Check write permissions and free space in ~/Downloads/, languages/ and help/. Replacement is rolled back; preserve any .pack-backup files if rollback fails.
packs.error.HM505: HM505: Matching HTML help missing, unreadable or contains unsupported content. Place <language-code>.html beside the JSON file or in the adjacent help/ folder. Only passive HTML without scripts or external embeds is allowed. Nothing was installed.
packs.download_hint: Language and matching help are first saved and verified in {directory}/languages/ and {directory}/help/. Only these downloaded files are deleted after successful installation. They remain if installation fails.
